agent_note: First-person retrospective past narration (Saeris) with a very heavy dialogue load -- 59/81 quotes are speech. Quotation marks survive on roughly half the dialogue; where absent I used vocatives ('Saeris Fane', 'Little Osha', 'Alchemist'), 2nd-person address, imperatives, and responsive/retort register, recorded per quote. All 15 event quotes are past, 0 present. Two quotes that read as aphorisms (q10136, q10147, q10148) were kept as dialogue because they are imperatives to a listener; only q10150 and q10170 are true unaddressed gnomic present. Past-tense worldbuilding exposition (q10154, q10172, q10187, q10197) filed event/past per the gnomic-is-present-only rule. Abstained on q10146 (conditional 'would'), q10160 (generic 2nd-person maxim in past tense), q10200 and q10201 (unmarked first-person present/future with no addressee -- the only quotes that could add present evidence).
